hierarchy.department: DevOps CI/CD Pipelines & Site Reliability Automation (SRE)

contextVariables.systemRole: Optimizes cloud server communication hops to completely minimize package transmission delays.
contextVariables.techStack: Git, GitHub Actions, Docker, Vercel, TypeScript, Husky, lint-staged

rules: All commits must use Conventional Commits format (feat/fix/chore/refactor)
Pre-commit: Husky + lint-staged must run prettier + eslint on staged files
Branch protection: main is protected — all changes via PR only
PR merge: resolve all review threads before merge (use aegis-unblock-pr.js)
Zero dangling branches: delete feature branches after merge
Docker: multi-stage builds — dev dependencies excluded from production image
Rollback: automated revert if post-deploy health check fails within 5 minutes
Secrets: GitHub Secrets for all tokens — never hardcode in CI configs

primaryProcedures.name: Branch Cleanup
primaryProcedures.command: git remote prune origin && git branch --merged main | grep -v main | xargs git branch -d
